points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable clean build succeeds in network-disabled benchmark image; all three registered unit/np2 mesh tests pass.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Case/output/restart controls and error handling exist; historical executable identity remains qualified.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate config, physics, mesh, partition, solver and output modules; 2-D scope remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal solver wrapper found; external authorship investigation not performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON selects mesh, controls and physics; CGNS reader supports multiple zones and MIXED sections.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor exchange plus tracked np1/8 comparisons; modest force differences and historic binary qualification remain.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity and bounded nonlinear updates exist; some steady final force drift limits confidence.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: All three safe registered unit/mesh-partition tests pass; no independent grid/time convergence study.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules, report and tools are organized; a frozen preconditioner and some numerical limitations are documented.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative ideal-gas equations and nondimensionalization documented in report.tex and physics source.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS multizone and MIXED connectivity, geometry and adjacency; both np2 mesh tests pass.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Conservative face residual with Rusanov/Roe choices; reported low-Mach force accuracy remains limited.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov production and optional Roe implementation documented; numerical diffusion remains a physical limitation.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic boundaries implemented; no-slip output uses boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ limited gradients with staged startup ramp; report.tex:92–98 discloses it, but no independent smooth-order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and positivity fallback; full reconstruction is restored before the late Re200 window.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier source and tangential force projection solver.cpp:276–323; several viscous force results are elevated.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady block method and 500-step force/residual plateau test; M2 laminar force changes 8.3% over last500.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF active residual checked before state mutation, 30000 steps and stable lift period; individual historical per-step ratios/binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only global mesh is reset before iterations, METIS and neighbor halo exchange; tracked np1/8 cases show modest changes.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight checkpoint-tracked packages passed recorded structural validation; case numerical credibility independently assessed.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded validator passed eight results/report; this is structural rather than numerical proof.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 lift oscillation is sustained and source target check is active; steady plateau/M2 force drift remains a limitation.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015/M080 laminar and Re20 drag are high versus reviewed peers; M2 laminar drift and inviscid comparison limit confidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All19 pages render with fields and histories; Re200 late drag is compressed by startup on the only force plot.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Methods, startup ramp, cases and comparisons documented; Re200 display and some accuracy analysis remain limited.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint tracks raw cases and report figures; selected Re20 field rerender is visually similar but not pixel-identical in this environment.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable build and all three safe unit/mesh tests pass; CLI/output and restart paths exist. Individual historic executable identity remains qualified.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS reader handles multiple zones, MIXED TRI/QUAD/BAR sections and boundary tags; np2 mesh tests pass.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face residual, Rusanov/Roe options and wall/farfield treatments implemented; low-Mach accuracy is limited by case evidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Least-squares reconstruction and limiter/positivity control implemented; initial reconstruction ramp is disclosed and no independent smooth-order proof.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier treatment and no-slip states present; solver.cpp:276–323 projects wall traction tangentially.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady block method and full active BDF residual stopping are present. Re200 tracks zero reported misses and periodic wake; steady force convergence and unbound binary limit confidence.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global preprocessing, METIS partition, neighbor halos and reductions; tracked np1/np8 comparisons show modest force differences, exact binaries qualified.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Eight tracked packages and real Re200 wake; elevated laminar/Re20 drag and M2 laminar tail drift limit physical validation.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: 19-page report supplies case fields, histories, source manifest and St; Re200 full-history force plot does not resolve late drag.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate config, physics, mesh, solver and output interfaces support extension, while geometry/physics remain two-dimensional.
